en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined street corner. A sidewalk runs along a fence, with tall mature trees casting shade. In the distance a steepled building, likely a church or seminary structure, rises above the trees. In the foreground, two women in long white dresses carry parasols and walk along the sidewalk, with another figure holding an umbrella further back. Large handwritten numbers in black and red ink appear across the lower center of the image.
